text: The fictional Aster council met in the north hall. Archive A places it in 412 of the invented Aster calendar.
Archive B also places the fictional Aster council in the north hall, but dates it to 413 of the invented Aster calendar.
The later copy uses a different calendar convention. That difference could explain the one-year discrepancy, but neither account settles the original year or identifies a chairperson.
